与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

Little by little, things began to change. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Best of all, the congregation shared communion on Sunday morning.

The experience taught Jack more than any book could. The plant garden looked quieter than usual that evening. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. The rare disease can paralyze the muscles within days.

People around Jack often share different ideas about the plant garden. Jack prefers windy weather when running in the zoo. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Cafés shade the old boulevard.

Jack is saving money to buy a ticket to Sydney. Jack has practiced chess for three years and won a prize last term. On Sunday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. The clown's antics made the whole audience laugh.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The green hill has become an important part of daily life.
